Both files score 100 with no findings from the design-system auditor.

The document verification screen is complete in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css`:

- **Overall progress**: a `ProgressBar` (approved/total) plus a summary alert (success when all approved, danger listing what's rejected).
- **Four document cards** (ID proof, address proof, bank statement, photo), each with an `IconTile`, title/description, a `Badge` showing status (not uploaded / under review / approved / rejected — always paired with an icon and text, never colour alone), a rejection-reason `Alert` when applicable, and a `FileUpload` control for uploading or replacing the file (mock upload progress simulated via a timer).
- Mock data for the four documents and their states is defined directly in `Screen.tsx`; no backend or extra files were touched.

I can't run the dev server to visually verify (per instructions), but the code is composed entirely from Syntara components/tokens and passed the design-system audit cleanly.
